name: ebay_search
description: Search active eBay listings (US marketplace). Returns title, price, condition, seller, thumbnail, and item_id per hit. Use ebay_get_item with the returned item_id for full detail.

category_id.description: eBay category ID to scope to (see ebay_get_categories)

filter.description: Advanced Browse API filter, e.g. "price:[20..100],conditions:{NEW},buyingOptions:{FIXED_PRICE}". See Browse docs.

name: ebay_get_item
description: Get full detail for a single eBay item. Accepts either the RESTful item ID ("v1|123456789|0") or the legacy numeric ID ("123456789").

item_id.description: RESTful ID (v1|XXX|0) or legacy numeric ID

name: ebay_get_categories
description: Get the eBay category subtree under category_id. Omit category_id for the top-level US categories. Returned ids feed into ebay_search.category_id.

category_id.description: Parent category ID. Omit for top-level US categories.
